clock: Time.get_ticks_usec between rendered SceneTree frames; not smoothed delta
monitor_note: Godot monitor values are engine CPU counters, not per-script GPU timings; sections_us are optional accumulated instrumentation, reset after each render sample. Monitor collection itself adds small overhead.
route: Village.START → PATHS[0] nodes 2…7 → reverse nodes 6…2 → Village.START, repeating town loop; no cave and no teleport
